about: Synthetic labelled cases for imprint selector-eval. Every turn and statement is invented.

cases.turn: Draft the release notes for the lantern sync service and list the breaking changes first.

candidates.statement: Release notes must list breaking changes before new features.
Never ship a release note without a migration step for each breaking change.
Use metric units in the garden planner charts.
Keep commit subjects under sixty characters.
When writing about the lantern service, call it the sync service, not the daemon.

cases.turn: The checkout tests fail on the tax rounding step; find the cause before changing the expected values.

candidates.statement: Do not change an expected value in a test to make it pass; find why it changed first.
Round money only at the final total, never per line.
Write release notes in plain English.
Prefer short variable names in loops.
Ask before deleting any fixture file.

cases.turn: Make the garden planner's watering chart readable on a phone.

candidates.statement: Use metric units in the garden planner charts.
Charts must stay legible at phone width without sideways scrolling.
Release notes must list breaking changes before new features.
Round money only at the final total, never per line.

cases.turn: Thanks, that is all for today.

candidates.statement: Keep commit subjects under sixty characters.
Ask before deleting any fixture file.
